text.tspan: The console asks about ONE item —
the one a label would teach most
re-weigh the answers we already have
one LLM call · sometimes a Jev pass
when refits stop helping, ask a better question
Only the outer path changes what Jev is asked.
The inner one cannot add information that is not already in the answers.
if it beats the incumbent out of fold
if it wins AND you approve it
